title: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros

entities.name: Geldan
entities.description: A thief and corporate retrieval agent in debt to Solidbodies Research, who takes one last job into the secret Uthros Combine installation and is drawn to the thing she finds there.

entities.name: Rezint
entities.description: Geldan's longtime partner, a former student of Illvoi script and former hustler, who accompanies her into Uthros and tries to talk her out of opening the doors.

entities.name: Velmenon
entities.description: A jellyfish-like Solidbodies Research contact who gives Geldan the job and the sensor gear.

entities.name: Solidbodies Research
entities.description: A research company that holds Geldan in a web of favors and sends her to spy on its rival at Uthros.

entities.name: Uthros Combine
entities.description: A rival research outfit whose secret facility in the core of Uthros is thought to hold something big.

entities.name: Illvoi
entities.description: Jellyfish-like beings who staff the Uthros Combine station and its sentries; the page calls them jellies.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A gas giant of colorful clouds and crushing gravity, ringed by refueling stations and salvage yards, with a secret research station in its core.

entities.name: Adagia
entities.description: Geldan's home world, where she picked native flowers for pharmaceutical companies as a child and which has sandstorms and monsters.

entities.name: Monoist alabile
entities.description: Heavy-duty black pressure suits that Geldan trades her ship for; they resist Uthros's pressure and give the wearer a feeling of power.

entities.name: Favor-hunters
entities.description: Debt collectors that Solidbodies threatens to set on Geldan if she fails.

entities.name: The World-Eater
entities.description: The corpse of a reality-bending titan embedded in the core of Uthros behind the doors, which the Illvoi seem to be trying to turn into a weapon; its pull overwhelms Geldan.

events.summary: Velmenon tells Geldan that Solidbodies will trade her to someone else if she does not take another job.
events.quote: There's nothing else you can do for us, Geldan. It's this or trading you in for something from someone else.

events.summary: Velmenon explains that Solidbodies is behind its rival the Uthros Combine and offers Geldan freedom from her debt if she gets into the Uthros facility.
events.quote: If you can get in, you will be free.

events.summary: Geldan agrees to the job and learns the plan: wear Velmenon's sensor vests, evade sentries, find the nonexistent installation and reach the doors near the core.
events.quote: Find the installation there—the one that doesn't exist.

events.summary: Geldan has traded her own ship for two Monoist pressure suits and now flies an ugly old Kav mining vessel.
events.quote: Geldan is still raw after trading in her own ship, a saucy, nimble thing, a place built to her own tastes

events.summary: Geldan and Rezint set out from the salvage yard, blending in with drifting ships.
events.quote: They start from the salvage yard near where the ship has been parked, following the stream of unmoored ships out, trying to blend in with them, directionless detritus.

events.summary: Rezint proposes skirting a storm to mask them from the sentries and Geldan accepts.
events.quote: "I'm convinced," Geldan says.

events.summary: A gust damages the plasma torches and the ship begins steering itself into the storm.
events.quote: a strong gust hits the ship with a violent cracking noise.

events.summary: Geldan loses control of the ship and the two ride out the storm strapped into their seats.
events.quote: I've lost wire and hydraulics, can't steer this anymore.

events.summary: Rezint reveals that the Solidbodies gear includes modules that seem to measure the wearers, which unsettles him.
events.quote: I think a few of them are measuring us.

events.summary: Geldan schemes to wear the vests but then sell the data to a competitor, noting the contract did not forbid it.
events.quote: But there was nothing in the contract about exclusivity.

events.summary: The damaged ship slips past the sentries disguised as storm debris.
events.quote: They make it through.

events.summary: Out of the storm the ship is badly damaged but is drawing closer to the core, and Geldan sends Rezint to check the lifeboat.
events.quote: the crack in the screen on the right side of the cockpit could succumb to the pressure at any time

events.summary: Geldan and Rezint put on Velmenon's monitoring gear and the Monoist suits, and Geldan feels the suit's power and the cell it represents.
events.quote: Until they get Solidbodies Research their data, Geldan and Rezint will never be free.

events.summary: The two abandon the mining ship and launch in the lifeboat.
events.quote: They pile in and launch.

events.summary: Geldan and Rezint dodge the ring sentries by following a large sleek monster.
events.quote: They dodge another set of sentries by following on the tail of a monster.

events.summary: They land on the research base at the core, where the crushing pressure presses on Geldan despite her suit.
events.quote: Geldan feels pressure bear down on her like the palm of a giant hand, inexorable and grinding and cruel.

events.summary: Three Illvoi on hovering chairs pass beneath the hidden pair, and one waves a tentacle without raising an alarm.
events.quote: Three Illvoi ride by, each perched delicately on their hovering chairs.

events.summary: An Illvoi researcher opens a wall terminal; Rezint glimpses it before the researcher leaves.
events.quote: an Illvoi comes out from the side passage they're about to move to and taps something in the wall.

events.summary: Rising winds hurl sharp rock at their suits, forcing them to break into the tunnels for cover.
events.quote: It takes her a few minutes to realize that it's small pieces of rock, something sharp and very hard, hitting the metal of her suit.

events.summary: Geldan smashes a way into one of the ornate tunnels and they squeeze inside.
events.quote: Breaking into one of the ornate tunnels is just as satisfying as Geldan imagined it would be.

events.summary: Geldan takes the Illvoi worker's stool, and Rezint reports what he read on the terminal.
events.quote: casually swiping the stool left by the Illvoi worker as she does.

events.summary: Rezint reports that the terminal text included words for big and for deity or ending.
events.quote: I saw the word for big, not that that's much help.

events.summary: Geldan and Rezint walk the tunnels toward the center, drawn on by a growing pull, and cross unopposed into the internal tunnels.
events.quote: At some point, they reach the boundary between the external passageways and the internal tunnels.

events.summary: They reach the unguarded doors, which look like a toxic-metal disposal unit.
events.quote: They round the corner, and there they are: the doors.

events.summary: Rezint warns that the terminal said world-eater and urges Geldan to turn back.
events.quote: Whatever that is, Geldan, it's not something you can pluck out of a room and bring home for your trophy shelf.

events.summary: Geldan and Rezint argue over whether to go through the doors.
events.quote: We ought to respect that by trying to get back out.

events.summary: Geldan crushes the stool she carried, realizing it is not enough to free her.
events.quote: Slowly, Geldan squeezes her fist, giant in the pressure suit, around the stool and watches it crumble.

events.summary: Geldan apologizes to Rezint and disconnects the Solidbodies gear, deciding to keep anything she finds for herself.
events.quote: She's given them everything she owes them.

events.summary: The door opens at her touch and Geldan looks through into the core.
events.quote: The door opens easily at her touch, like it's been waiting for her.

events.summary: Geldan sees the corpse of a titan embedded in the core and falls to her knees before it.
events.quote: The corpse of a titan.

events.summary: Geldan surrenders to the titan's pull, resolving to let it remake her.
events.quote: She will be the clay.

events.summary: An alarm wails behind her as Rezint shouts in her headset; Geldan hopes he escapes and stays.
events.quote: Rezint's voice is in her headset, shouting something.

relations.note: Velmenon is Geldan's Solidbodies Research contact.
relations.quote: Geldan's Solidbodies Research contact, Velmenon, stares at her from across the table.

relations.note: Geldan works off her debt of favors to Solidbodies.
relations.quote: If you can get in, you will be free.

relations.note: Solidbodies is a rival of the Uthros Combine and wants to learn its secret.
relations.quote: Our research and development teams are being outflanked by those gas-for-brains at the Uthros Combine.

relations.note: Partner who has repeatedly followed Geldan out of trouble.
relations.quote: You get us out of this, and I'll do whatever you want.

relations.note: Its station is built into and out of the planet's core.
relations.quote: The Uthros Combine station is built both into and out of the core of the gas giant it takes its name from.

relations.note: Its corpse is embedded in the planet's core behind the doors.
relations.quote: she sees the tip of a nightmare embedded in the metal core of the planet.

relations.note: Geldan breaks from Solidbodies, refusing their pickup.
relations.quote: She won't meet their stupid ship—not until she has something better.
